一個合理解釋是，程式中的固定格式、重複名稱與括號較容易被草稿猜中，較長的草稿因而: One plausible explanation is that fixed syntax, repeated identifiers, and brackets in code are easier for the draft model to predict, making longer drafts more useful. Prose allows different choices of expression. Prompt length, sampling, quantization, and engine overhead may also contribute; this test has not isolated their effects.

Coding assistant tasks cover code generation and terminal simulation, not end-to-end autonomous-agent success.
For Gemma 4 31B QAT on counseling text, Q4 N=4 was only about 0.5% faster than N=3; both are worth trying. For a simple starting point, try Q4 N=2, then compare N=3 and N=4 on your own prompts. E4B also merits a separate Q8 test.

把「這批資料顯示什麼」與「還不能推論什麼」分開，讓設定建議有可追溯的依據。: Separate what the data shows from what it cannot yet establish, with traceable evidence behind the setup suggestions.
NAS 環境紀錄：Mac Studio、Apple M3 Ultra，32 核心: NAS environment record: Mac Studio, Apple M3 Ultra, 32-core CPU (24 performance + 8 efficiency cores), 256GB unified memory, and Darwin 25.6.0 arm64. The project owner separately confirmed the 80-core GPU.
推論環境記載 llama.cpp v0.7.0、commit 620d2225c: The environment record lists llama.cpp v0.7.0, commit 620d2225c, Metal, f16 KV cache, and Metal peer memory. These are recorded settings; the test machine was not revisited to verify them during this analysis.
6 模型 × 各自可用設定 × 5 題，共 250 個條件、1,250 次執行。: 6 models × their available configurations × 5 prompts = 250 conditions and 1,250 runs. Five models have a baseline plus Q4/Q8 × N1–4; Qwen 3.8 27B has a baseline plus Q4 × N1–4 only. Every configuration uses a 16,384-token context window. Window size was not varied; input length varies with prompt and tokenizer.
舊 README 說 Flash Next 只測 baseline，但 JSON: The old README says Flash Next had baseline-only tests, but the JSON contains Q4/Q8, N1–4, and nonzero acceptance rates, so analysis follows the recorded measurements. The old report script says v0.6.0, the environment file says v0.7.0, and the runner has version fallback logic. Without full execution logs, a consistent binary version across all runs cannot be guaranteed. E4B Q4 and Q8 are both labeled 94MB; actual GGUF types and file sizes remain unverified.
每個模型×設定×題目，先算 5 次生成速度的算術平均。: For each model × configuration × prompt, take the arithmetic mean of generation speed across 5 runs.
在同模型、同題目內，除以不開 MTP 的速度，得到加速比。: Divide by the MTP-off speed for the same model and prompt to obtain a speed ratio.
對加速比取幾何平均；模型等權重，兩類任務各佔 50%，類內題目等權重。: Aggregate ratios with geometric means. Models are weighted equally, the two task types each receive 50%, and prompts within each task type are weighted equally.
共同設計使用 Q4。Q8/Q4 比較只用五個條件完整的模型，於同題目、同 N 配: The common design uses Q4. Q8/Q4 comparisons include only the five complete models, paired within the same prompt and N. The baseline has no Q level and is not duplicated as two independent observations.
加速比 = mean(speed_MTP) / mean(speed_basel:
Speed ratio = mean(speed_MTP) / mean(speed_baseline)
Speed gain (%) = (speed ratio - 1) × 100
Aggregate = exp(weighted_mean(log(speed ratio)))
1.41× 約等於每秒輸出多 41%。固定輸出量時，僅生成階段的時間比例約為 1: A ratio of 1.41× means about 41% more tokens per second. With a fixed output length, generation time alone would be about 1/1.41 of baseline. This is not a conversion of measured end-to-end waiting time: prefill and output length also affect elapsed time.
公開實測怎麼說？這次補上什麼？: Published benchmarks: what does this test add?
以下是截至 2026-10-22 查閱的一手資料：官方實作說明、實測作者的原始報: These primary sources were reviewed through 2026-10-22: official implementation notes, original benchmark reports, and a research paper. This is a focused review, not an exhaustive survey. Hardware, quantization, engines, and prompts differ, so the numbers should not be ranked directly against one another.
Aider polyglot 程式代理測試，生成速度平均提升近 90%；實作會動: Nearly 90% higher average generation speed on the Aider polyglot coding-agent benchmark; the implementation adapts draft length at runtime.
支持依工作負載調整的方向。本站是固定 N 的 llama.cpp／GGUF，助理: Supports workload-specific tuning. This site uses fixed N with llama.cpp/GGUF, and its assistant prompts are not full Aider runs; these numbers do not reproduce Ollama's result.
程式題估計 tok/s 約 1.87×；多任務單輪測試指出程式、JSON、擷取較: About 1.87× estimated tok/s on coding prompts. A broader single-round task matrix found larger gains for code, JSON, and extraction; creative or very short prompts could be flat or slower.
任務差異已有前例。本站補入諮商輔導領域及固定 N1–4、草稿 Q4/Q8；本站用: Task differences have precedent. This test adds counseling-domain text, fixed N1–4, and draft Q4/Q8. It uses engine-reported generation rates rather than estimates converted from character counts.
單流 K=3：數學 99.9、程式 78.9、聊天 76.9 tok/s；各自基: At single-stream K=3: math 99.9, code 78.9, and chat 76.9 tok/s, against baselines of 44.1, 44.3, and 44.2 respectively. Concurrency and acceptance by draft position were also tested.
工作負載差異不限於 Gemma，程式也不是任何題組都最受益。本站增加 Apple: Workload dependence extends beyond Gemma, and coding does not always benefit most. This test adds domain-specific prose on Apple Silicon. Both K and our N concern draft length, but implementation-specific counting conventions still need checking.
MoE 驗證多個 token 可能啟用更多專家，額外讀取權重會抵銷收益；硬體與批: Verifying several tokens in an MoE model can activate more experts; extra weight reads may offset the gains. Hardware and batch size affect the outcome.
這提供解釋本站 MoE 高 N 收益下降的可能機制，但本站沒有直接量測專家載入成: A possible mechanism for the declining high-N gains in our MoE models, but expert-loading costs were not directly measured here.
在 LLaMA-65B、OPT-66B 的廣泛實驗中，草稿延遲是效能的重要因素；: Extensive experiments with LLaMA-65B and OPT-66B identify draft latency as an important performance factor. Draft language-model capability is not the same as acceleration capability.
屬一般 speculative decoding 研究，並非本次 Gemma/Q: This is general speculative-decoding research, not direct validation of our Gemma/Qwen MTP setup. It motivates measuring acceptance alongside computation costs.
任務依賴性並非本站首次發現；領域素材、硬體及設定組合，是這批資料對既有實測的補充: This site does not claim to be the first to find task dependence. Its contribution is the domain material, hardware, and configuration comparison.
固定 Q4、N=4：任務差異有多大？: Fixed Q4, N=4: how large are the task differences?
以下全部比較相同的草稿 Q 與 N，避免把「兩類任務各自挑最佳設定」的差別混進來: Every comparison below holds draft Q and N constant, avoiding differences introduced by choosing a separate best configuration for each task. Each gain uses the same model's within-prompt MTP-off baseline. The final column is a percentage-point difference, not how many percent faster coding is than counseling.
E4B 與 12B 的差距醒目，31B 也有相近程度的差距。若改看 N1→N4: E4B and 12B show striking gaps, but 31B has a similar gap. The N1→N4 task interaction is about +22.3%, +23.6%, and +21.7% respectively. This supports testing task-specific N for smaller models as a deployment hypothesis, but not a monotonic rule that smaller models have larger differences.
下一輪，哪些驗證最能幫到社群？: What should the community test next?
優先回答能改變架設決策的問題。下列是假設與建議設計，尚未執行；不是本站已證實的結: Prioritize questions that could change deployment decisions. The hypotheses and suggested designs below have not yet been tested; they are not established findings of this benchmark.
1 · 依任務選 N，可能比固定 N 更實用: 1 · Task-specific N may be more useful than a fixed N
每類先準備約 10–20 道獨立題目作探索起點（不是統計保證）；拆成選設定與驗證: Start with roughly 10–20 independent prompts per task as an exploratory set, not a statistical guarantee. Split them into tuning and validation sets. Compare fixed N2, fixed N4, and task-specific N on held-out prompts and mixed workflows, measuring elapsed time and quality.
提供可以重跑的領域題組與任務設定參考；即使結果不支持分流，也能知道固定 N 已足: Reusable domain-specific prompts and configuration references. Even a negative result can show when one fixed N is sufficient.
2 · 可預測性可能比任務名稱更能解釋差異: 2 · Predictability may explain more than the task label
以相同內容做自由文字、JSON、程式／固定格式等版本，盡量匹配輸入長度、輸出預算: Express the same content as free-form prose, JSON, and code or other fixed formats, matching input length, output budget, and sampling as closely as possible. Record acceptance and actual speed at each N; include drafting and verification time if the engine exposes them.
分清楚是領域本身、輸出格式，還是計算成本在影響收益；避免把所有聊天或程式歸為同一: Distinguish domain, output format, and computation cost instead of treating all chat or coding as a single workload.
3 · 小模型可能更值得按任務調校: 3 · Smaller models may benefit more from task-specific tuning
優先擴充 E4B、12B 的獨立題目，並保留 31B 作對照；固定主模型量化與軟: Expand independent prompts for E4B and 12B, retaining 31B as a comparison. Hold main-model quantization and software version fixed. Compare the extra benefit of task-specific settings over the best fixed N, not just the distance between task curves.
檢驗小模型部署假設是否成立。要談大小規律，還需更多可比的同家族模型；MoE 啟用: Test the small-model deployment hypothesis. A size trend requires more comparable models in the same family; active MoE parameters should not be treated as equivalent to dense-model size.
4 · 最佳 N 可能隨 context、並行及快取改變: 4 · The best N may change with context, concurrency, and caching
將同一核心任務搭配不同長度的背景，控制輸出要求；分別測單請求及實際服務並行，區分: Pair the same core task with different background lengths while controlling output requirements. Test single requests and real service concurrency, separating cold and warm caches. Record time to first token, per-request latency, and aggregate throughput.
把單機單流結果接到真實服務需求；識別什麼負載下應降低 N 或關閉 MTP。: Connect single-stream measurements to real services and identify when to reduce N or disable MTP.
5 · Q8 的收益可能取決於接受率能否抵銷成本: 5 · Q8 may help only when acceptance offsets its extra cost
先核對草稿 GGUF 型別、檔案大小與雜湊，特別是本紀錄 E4B Q4/Q8 都: Verify draft GGUF types, sizes, and hashes first, particularly the questionable E4B Q4/Q8 labels that both say 94MB. Then interleave Q4/Q8 runs with the same prompts, N, and sampling.
讓草稿量化比較可追溯；分辨 Q8 何時值得多用記憶體，而非只看接受率高低。: Make draft-quantization comparisons traceable and identify when Q8 justifies extra memory, rather than focusing on acceptance alone.
公開題目應使用全新合成或確實去識別的內容，保留領域術語、格式與長度分布；先確定沒: Use new synthetic or thoroughly de-identified public prompts while retaining domain terminology, formats, and length distributions. Exclude student identifiers, counseling records, and passwords. Record prompt-set versions, model/draft hashes, engine commit, hardware, sampling, output limits, and actual output lengths. Start with 3–5 runs per prompt and configuration, shuffle order across batches, and track quality and tool success separately.
測試順序隨機化、首字等待及品質評分需要另增工具；本站公開 runner 目前仍是: Randomized order, time to first token, and quality scoring require additional tooling; the published runner still uses its original fixed order. Share per-run metrics, prompt-set specifications, and analysis code; keep protected material and outputs local. The most useful next deliverable is a method others can run on their own material and compare using a shared synthetic prompt set.

MTP 與量化的模型差異: Model differences in MTP and quantization
Main-model quantization is fixed within each model: UD-Q4_K_XL for all four Gemma models, UD-Q8_K_XL for Qwen 3.8 27B, and UD-Q6_K_XL for Flash Next. This is not a comparison with identical main-model quantization across models.
交互作用不只問哪類任務快，而是「提高 N 後，兩類任務的收益是否不同」。以 N1: Interaction asks not merely which task is faster, but whether raising N changes the benefit differently across tasks. Relative to N1, calculate [(Coding N / Coding N1) / (Counseling N / Counseling N1)] − 1.
五個 Q 完整模型改以 Q4/Q8 等權重：N1–4 分別提升 +24.2%、+: With Q4/Q8 weighted equally across the five complete models, N1–4 gains are +24.2%, +39.6%, +39.4%, and +37.3%. N2 slightly exceeds N3. The best overall N depends on model composition and weighting.

MoE 組為 Gemma 4 26B A4B QAT 與 Qwen 3.8 Fl: The MoE group contains Gemma 4 26B A4B QAT and Qwen 3.8 Flash Next; the other four are classified as non-MoE. Architecture references:
。MoE 僅兩模型，且家族、大小、量化、草稿成本同時改變；不能把差異視為架構本身: . There are only two MoE models, and family, size, quantization, and draft cost vary together. The differences cannot be interpreted as causal effects of architecture alone.

baseline 的輔導三題依序為短、中、長輸入。下表呈現輸入 tokens／生: The three baseline counseling prompts have short, medium, and long inputs respectively. The table reports input tokens / generation tok/s. The longest prompt was about 1.8%–5.9% slower than the shortest, but content and output length also differ, so this is not a pure length effect.
大小與模型身分綁定。E4B 的有效參數、MoE 總參數與啟用參數，以及權重檔案: Size is tied to model identity. 例如 Gemma 4 31B QAT 相對 E4B 的上述交互作用比值為 0.9: For example, the interaction ratio for Gemma 4 31B QAT relative to E4B is 0.99496, a difference of about −0.50%. This descriptive three-way contrast cannot establish statistical significance or prove an absence of interaction.
穩定度、資料限制與下一輪測試: Stability, limitations, and the next test round
排除各條件第一次執行後，Q4 平均提升 +40.8%；12 個模型×任務組合的最: Excluding the first run in each condition gives an average Q4 gain of +40.8%; the best Q4 N is unchanged in all 12 model × task combinations.
有 14 個條件的第一次執行仍有快取，不能一律視為完全 cold。: The first run still had cached tokens in 14 conditions, so first runs cannot all be treated as fully cold.
輸出範圍為 1,022–4,096 tokens；181 次恰達 4,096 上: Outputs range from 1,022 to 4,096 tokens. Exactly 181 runs reached the 4,096-token limit, but stop reasons were not saved, so truncation cannot be confirmed per run.
Q4 MTP 的平均 wall time 比值下降約 28.7%，輸出量平均差約: The average Q4 MTP wall-time ratio decreased by about 28.7%; average output length differed by about −0.15%. Output lengths still vary in individual conditions.
條件內生成速度的變異係數中位數 1.68%、最大 14.02%。最快與次快相差很: The within-condition generation-speed coefficient of variation has a median of 1.68% and a maximum of 14.02%. Small gaps between the fastest and runner-up settings should be checked in new batches.
五次執行是技術重複，不是五道獨立題目。本報告不將 1,250 筆當成獨立樣本計算: Five runs are technical repeats, not five independent prompts. This report does not treat the 1,250 runs as independent samples for p-values or population-level confidence intervals.
原 runner 固定順序測試，未指定 seed，且沒有硬體溫度、功耗或背景負載: The original runner uses fixed order with no specified seed, and records no hardware temperature, power, or background load. Batch and order effects cannot be excluded.
接受率不是回答正確率。未評分內容品質，也沒有完整 Agent 工具執行的成功率資: Acceptance rate is not answer accuracy. Response quality was not scored, and no end-to-end agent tool-success data was collected.
下一輪應讓每類任務有多道獨立題目，每題交叉多種輸入長度，控制輸出預算，隨機化設定: The next round should include multiple independent prompts per task, crossed with input lengths, controlled output budgets, randomized configuration order, and repeated batches. Separate cold and warm conditions. Select N on one prompt set and validate on held-out prompts. Size or architecture effects require more comparable models, not just more repeats of the same configuration.

MTP用小模型幫主要模型打好草稿: MTP uses a small model to draft ahead for the main model
能否省時間，取決於預測帶來的收益是否超過額外成本。本測試發現MTP普遍能提升生成: Whether MTP saves time depends on whether the benefits of prediction outweigh its extra cost. In this test, MTP generally improved generation performance, but the gains differed by workload. The best number of draft tokens also varied by model and task.
N 是草稿模型一次預測的Token數，通常一次預測越多，主要模型接受的比例也越低: N is the number of tokens the draft model predicts in one step. Predicting more tokens usually lowers the proportion accepted by the main model, so overall generation performance still needs to be measured. This benchmark tested N = 1–4.
這裡的 Q 指草稿模型量化程度。Q8 通常需要更多記憶體、運算量也會增加，因此擬: Q here refers to draft-model quantization. Q8 generally needs more memory and computation, increasing drafting time, while theoretically improving draft quality and acceptance. Overall generation performance therefore needs empirical testing. This benchmark compared Q4 and Q8 drafts wherever measurements were available.

第 1 題｜晤談方向與策略建議: Prompt 1 | Directions and strategies for a follow-up session
根據一段親密關係相關的諮商情境，請模型整理值得進一步理解的議題，並提出後續晤談的: Given a counseling scenario involving an intimate relationship, identify issues to explore further and suggest directions and strategies for a follow-up session. Only the task is described; case details and session text remain private.
根據來信撰寫自然、具同理心的輔導回覆，包含情緒回應、心理衛教、DBT 技巧與資源: Write a natural, empathetic reply to a message, incorporating emotional support, psychoeducation, DBT skills, and resource referrals. Follow the requested prose format: no bullet points and only the letter itself.
第 3 題｜長篇諮商紀錄的結案整理: Prompt 3 | Summarizing lengthy counseling records at closure
閱讀多次晤談的長篇紀錄，整理成簡要結案摘要，涵蓋主訴、初步評估、輔導處遇、工作同: Read lengthy records spanning multiple sessions and produce a concise closing summary covering presenting concerns, initial assessment, interventions, therapeutic alliance, future needs, and family and social support.
第 4 題｜Python 非同步批次處理與重試系統: Prompt 4 | Python asynchronous batch processing and retries
撰寫 AsyncBatchProcessor，整合並發控制、批次聚合、重試、限流: Implement AsyncBatchProcessor with concurrency control, batching, retries, rate limiting, type annotations, and graceful shutdown, plus a standalone simulation and summary statistics.
針對服務啟動失敗、資料庫無法連線與磁碟容量不足的情境，產生分階段的診斷、原因分析: For a scenario involving a failed service, an unreachable database, and a full disk, generate staged diagnosis, root-cause analysis, repair, and verification steps with simulated commands and output. The task does not require operating a real server.
